Hyderabad Police Arrest 36 in Cyber Fraud Crackdown, Recover Funds

Hyderabad cyber crime police have arrested 36 individuals across five states as part of a crackdown on cyber fraud in June. The operation resulted in the recovery of approximately ₹49 lakh. This action addresses the growing concern of online financial crimes.
